content.rendered:
Shared laws, commands and teaching applying to all within the stated audience or conditions. General does not remove covenant, historical, priestly or household limits. Read the existing Transformed, Fulfilled, Unchanged, Everlasting and other classifications alongside each entry.

Some source records still need their audience resolved. These are explicitly marked audience review pending; their provisional filing here is not a claim that they apply universally. Passage groups may contain both shared teaching and personal directions.

General · Personal · Instructions overview

3,869 study records in this view. Entries can overlap; this is not a count of distinct biblical commands. Ordered by the first source book, chapter and verse.

The source wording follows the Saints Greek-English text: the Septuagint for the Old Testament and the Greek New Testament. Headings and application notes are study summaries. Preserve the passage’s speaker, audience, conditions and grammatical form. Source alignment checked 6 November 2026; independent critical-Greek review remains in progress.
